description: Trial switching the radio off and on over CAT (station stopped, no transmission)
start: Trial of radio {model} on {port}: switch-off then switch-on over CAT. No transmission.
not_on: The radio does not answer as switched on: switch it on at the shack, check the USB cable, then try again.
tx_before: The radio was transmitting: return-to-receive command (T 0) sent. Trial stopped.
off_failed: The radio did not switch off (command refused or the radio still answers « on »). Remote power is not possible with this radio or cable.
port_gone: Port {port} disappeared once the radio was off: this radio cuts its USB and cannot be switched on remotely. Switch it on at the shack (ON/OFF button).
port_changed: Port {port} no longer has the same USB identity once the radio is off: trial stopped. Switch the radio on at the shack.
step_on: 3/3 Switching the radio on again ({seconds} s at most)…
on_failed: The radio did not switch on within {seconds} s: switch it on at the shack (ON/OFF button). Remote power is not possible this way.
tx_after: The radio came back TRANSMITTING: return-to-receive command (T 0) sent at once. Check the PTT line (RTS / DTR) before switching the feature on.
on_ok: Radio back on in {seconds} s: {freq} {mode}, receiving.
result_ok: Trial PASSED: the radio switches off and on over CAT.
result_failed: Trial FAILED: feature not switched on.
no_rigctl: rigctl (Hamlib) not found: install Hamlib or set [tools] hamlib_dir.
restore: Switching the radio back on as a precaution…
restore_failed: The radio did not come back on: switch it on at the shack (ON/OFF button).
